d:
Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath’s mother, Savitri Devi, passed away at the age of 91 at her ancestral home in Panchur village, Pauri, Uttarakhand, following a prolonged illness, with her last rites scheduled for November 21, which CM Yogi will attend. The tragic news broke while CM Yogi was distributing tablets to students in Gorakhpur, prompting Prime Minister Narendra Modi to speak with him and offer his condolences.
